mapper.sql: id, actor_identity_id AS actor, idempotency_key AS key, tenant_id AS tenantId, plan_id AS planId, ends_at AS endsAt, created_at AS createdAt, replay_until AS replayUntil, response_body::TEXT AS responseBody
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscription_recovery(actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, tenant_id, plan_id, ends_at, created_at, replay_until) VALUES (#{actor}, #{key}, #{tenantId}, #{planId}, #{endsAt}, #{createdAt}, #{replayUntil}) ON CONFLICT (actor_identity_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM subscription_recovery WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT FROM subscription_recovery WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND id = #{id}
SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', CAST(#{tenantId} AS TEXT), true)

SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id) AND (r.ends_at IS NULL OR r.ends_at::TIMESTAMPTZ > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plans p JOIN plan_quotas q ON q.plan_id = p.id WHERE p.id = r.plan_id AND p.plan_status = 'ACTIVE' AND q.quota_limit >= 1) FROM subscription_recovery r WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE subscription_recovery SET response_body = CAST(#{responseBody} AS JSONB), replay_until = #{replayUntil} WHERE id = #{id} AND actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND response_body IS NULL
